## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `dev` (or `main` for a release or hotfix)
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Tests added for the new behavior, including denial and cross-tenant cases where relevant
- [ ] The whole feature is in this PR, not a single small task
- [ ] `docs/log/` entry added for each task
- [ ] Docs updated if a rule or decision changed
- [ ] Both language catalogs updated for any UI text
- [ ] Plain ASCII punctuation in code and commits; no AI attribution
- [ ] Branch pushed to all three remotes
